payload.summary: No new test is recommended. The one uncovered line, the entry point in cmd/go-todo/main.go, already has end-to-end tests: they build the binary and check both `list` and the no-argument usage path. Those tests run it in a separate process, which in-process coverage cannot measure. All 5 mutants on the changed lines in internal/ were killed. Gremlins applies only a few kinds of mutation, so the `!item.Done` filter and the argument-count check were not mutated. The tests already pin both of them with exact-output assertions.
